title: scandal_in_bohemia
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
summary: Sherlock Holmes is hired by the King of Bohemia to recover a compromising photograph held by the adventuress Irene Adler; Holmes locates it through a clever ruse but is ultimately outwitted by Adler, who flees with the photograph, earning his lasting admiration.
